component: tool-call grammar during generation: auto alternation, call quantifiers, tools + JSON answer, engaged-grammar streaming
modifications: Ported the grammar shapes of Splash tool_grammar (required: calls+ / exactly one; auto: text with calls* / calls?; response_format: calls or answer) from llguidance Lark to mlx2's regex dialect, composed around each adapter's existing tool_constraint block instead of one hard-coded Qwen wire format.
Replaced Splash's TEXT & ~/.*<tool_call>.*/ complement with a lookaround-free block construction so mlx2's exact token automaton compiles it.
Kept thinking outside the grammar (mlx2 defers the grammar past the adapter thinking-close marker) rather than folding a think rule into it.
No llguidance dependency and no Splash code copied; matcher caching and native bitmask filling were not ported.
